title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30416: add purchase budget navigation events
summary: The purchase budget overview matrix page now exposes before and after integration events around record navigation calls, allowing extensions to adjust Item Budget Name filters during navigation without replacing standard behavior.
key_points: New before/after events added to OnFindRecord and OnNextRecord triggers
Events include an Item Budget Name parameter that extensions can modify
Enables filter adjustments during record navigation without replacing base functionality
Addresses extensibility need for purchase budget overview matrix navigation
quote: Extensions need to adjust Item Budget Name filters while the purchase budget overview matrix navigates records.
